title: Vaporesso Dojo Blast Fresh Prefilled Pod & Refill  – Berry Lemonade
description: Revitalise your Dojo Blast vape with the Berry Lemonade Prefilled Pod & Refill Pack, designed for seamless use with the entire Vaporesso Dojo Blast range. Utilising the unique INSTA-JUICED structure, this smart system keeps your 20mg nicotine salt completely sealed away from the coil until the moment you connect them, ensuring optimal freshness. Berry Lemonade is a bright fusion pairing British Malling Centenary Strawberry and Tulameen Raspberry with zesty Meyer Lemon. The sweet, juicy berry notes perfectly counteract the sharp, citrus-forward Lemonade base, creating a sparkling and immensely refreshing all-day profile. Each pod and refill pack is fully compatible with all Dojo Blast kits, offering up to 10,000 puffs* per pack. Powered by an advanced COREX BLAST dual-mesh coil, it guarantees consistently dense vapour and exceptional flavour reproduction. How to Set Up Your Dojo Blast Fresh Pod: Remove the 2ml pod and the 10ml refill container from the packaging. Remove the red silicone plug from the top of the 2ml empty pod. Slide the 10ml refill container securely into the 2ml pod to assemble the pack. Wait for exactly five minutes to allow the e-liquid to fully saturate the coil. Insert the assembled pack into your Dojo Blast device and inhale to vape. *Puff counts are approximate and dependent on the length of each draw. Total puffs may vary.
